integrity: The complete Theorem 6.3 parameter space is enumerated exactly: 96 invertible 2x2 matrices over F2+uF2 times 16 choices of E. All 64 words of every resulting free rank-3 code are enumerated, and binary Gray rank, LCD Gram rank, distance, and weight distributions are recomputed from the displayed source matrices.
scientific_limitations: The census fixes the source generator, coordinate labeling, and displayed matrix U from Example 7.5. It does not classify the 1536 embeddings up to arbitrary coordinate permutation or prove that each optimal weight-enumerator type is a single equivalence class.
title: A complete census of the shortest LCD embeddings in Example 7.5
